question: In a certain code language, 'MAYOR’ is written as 'WSBCN' and 'MARCH' is written as 'MGUCN'. How will 'ISSUE' be written in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9b1ef5af07dc7cdface0347994bbc6f824cbda2bac27bcab0cb4cf07968dfa00.png] 

The logic followed here is:

For, 'MAYOR’ is written as 'WSBCN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d5b209ddeaceada2fb49b598909125f5f2085dbb766c8604b3ae511bfdc17f7d.png] 

For, 'MARCH' is written as 'MGUCN',

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9e0d77b381a2a119c5cd034bac178f9366afeb97fb401001f946afcc8477d563.png] 

Similarly, for '**ISSUE**'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/890781e41fcbf00449745df137a76192da3fa57287fd28b10ce7e2d415ad805f.png] 

So, 'ISSUE' is coded as '**JYVUJ**'.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
